findings.reason: §6 cannot produce any of its landed figures without the imported rows s4 owns, so the declaration sends a node at work whose inputs do not exist.
findings.text: §6 declares `data-status="implementable"` and the document declares s6 implementable, but its declared dependency s4 (line 58) is `deferred` until the one-off document fetch fills the private store, and s4 is where §6's components, their linked context and the functional specification it reads forty descriptions against all come from; a dispatcher reading declarations alone would start §6 with no linked context to describe from and no reference to measure against

findings.reason: an implementable section that states no model is chosen leaves the worker either stalled on a closed decision or free to pick a seat, and one line naming the recorded choice removes both.
findings.text: §6's Delivers still reads "the one the lead names when answering the open decision on description quality; until that decision is answered no model is chosen for this section", while the decision `local-model-confirmed-on-quality` is answered `local-confirmed` by the lead at 2026-11-17T15:53:44 (line 120) and its rationale names the locally served model with the grounded settings on the primary branch; the section is simultaneously marked implementable, so a worker reads a precondition that no longer gates and must infer the model from elsewhere in the plan
